_doc: Revert-verify mutants for ems__Bug 530f895d — the identity function `listItemIdentity` itself (subject yamlScalar.ts). Sibling spec `wikilink-identity-530f895d.executor.spec.json` mutates the call sites. M2–M9 lock the BOUNDARIES the call-site mutants cannot reach: identity is the link TARGET, never the display alias (K7, K9); only a value that is exactly ONE wikilink is unwrapped — a pipe in a plain alias is text (K8), a value holding two links is text (K23); the identity of a link keeps the LINK FORM, so a bare uid is a different value (K10, K11); whitespace before/after the link or around its target is not trimmed, because the RDF converter reads such a value as a literal (K16, K17, K22); an empty target is its own value (K18). Mutants are type-preserving (no `if (false)`), per integration-test-revert-verify §A36. Run from the repo root: python3 -I ~/.claude/bin/mutant-driver.py <this file> after setting `tree` and `subject` to YOUR checkout.
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/core/src/utilities/yamlScalar.ts

M1_identity_off._note: Nothing is ever recognised as a wikilink — identity degenerates to the whole string at the three identity sites at once (the byte-based #4432 refusal is unaffected).

M2_identity_is_alias._note: The display ALIAS is taken as identity instead of the target: two different classes sharing the alias `ems__Task` become one value (K7, K9) and the aliased/plain pairs stop matching.

M3_any_pipe_is_alias._note: A pipe in ANY value is read as an alias separator — the `aliases` label `Foo | Bar` collapses onto `Foo`. Only pipe-bearing values are touched, so the mutant has one concern (no trimming of other plain values).

M4_identity_is_bare_target._note: The identity of a link is the BARE target instead of the link form: a bare uid (no brackets) collides with the link — a bare `from` replaces the link (K10) and append skips the link next to the bare uid (K11). This was the shape of the planning-stage prototype (ems__Bug 530f895d, StageSpecification).

M5_outer_whitespace_trimmed._note: Whitespace AROUND the value is trimmed before matching: ` [[uid]]` / `[[uid]] ` (literals for the RDF converter) swallow the working link appended next to them (review MEDIUM-1 of the spec stage).

M6_target_whitespace_trimmed._note: Whitespace around the link TARGET is trimmed: `[[ uid ]]` (a literal for the RDF converter) swallows the working link appended next to it (review MEDIUM-1).

M7_empty_target_merged._note: The empty-target guard is dropped: `[[|x]]` and `[[|y]]` both become `[[]]` and the second is never written.

M8_more_than_one_link_is_a_link._note: The target class `[^[\]]+` is widened to `.+`: a value holding two links (`[[a|x]] and [[b]]`) is read as ONE link to `a` and swallows `[[a]]` (review LOW-4 of PR #4563).

M9_unanchored_end._note: The `$` anchor is dropped: anything AFTER a leading link is ignored — `[[uid]] ` (a literal for the RDF converter) and `[[a|x]] and [[b]]` swallow the working link appended next to them (review LOW-4 of PR #4563).
